metaTitle: Work Hours Calculator — when do I finish, how many hours? — DoneAt
metaDescription: Work out your finish time from your start time, hours and lunch break, or how many hours a shift is after an unpaid break. Night shifts included. Free, in your browser.
heading: Work hours calculator
intro: See when your day ends, or how many hours a shift really is. Unpaid breaks come off, and shifts past midnight end the next day.
timeAtWork: {{duration}} from start to finish, break included
invalidBreak: The break is as long as the shift. Shorten it or change the times.
invalidSpan: That adds up to a full day. Try fewer hours or a shorter break.
adTitle: Keep the end of your day in view
adBody: DoneAt counts down to the end of your shift on your Home Screen, desktop and menu bar, reminds you before you leave, and handles rotating rosters.
howBody: Hours worked is the time from start to finish minus any unpaid break. When the end time is earlier than the start, the shift runs past midnight and ends the next day.
Your finish time is your start time plus the hours you need to work plus the break. Everything is worked out in your browser; nothing you enter is sent anywhere.
